item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00477","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C24","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.82,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied concrete drafting material for the child. Both directives implement national-defense production or procurement authority through departmental delegations, permit action notwithstanding laws governing the making, performance, amendment, or modification of contracts, contemplate regulations or procedures that are uniform to the extent practicable, and authorize redelegation. The child substantially expands this shared contracting machinery into detailed rules for Defense and then extends it to Commerce. C24 and C04 share the defense-mobilization delegation framework and assignments to Commerce, but lack the child's distinctive contracting provisions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"to enter into contracts ... and to make advance, progress, and other payments thereon, without regard to the provisions of law relating to the making, performance, amendment, or modification of contracts","parent_excerpt":"in order to expedite production and deliveries or services under Government contracts, and without regard to provisions of law relating to the making, performance, amendment, or modification of contracts","explanation":"This is a distinctive, nearly verbatim statement of exceptional national-defense contracting authority."},{"child_excerpt":"Under such regulations, which shall be uniform to the extent practicable","parent_excerpt":"regulations governing the forms and procedures (which shall be uniform to the extent practicable)","explanation":"Both impose the same practical-uniformity standard on regulations governing extraordinary defense-related financial or contracting action."},{"child_excerpt":"may delegate such authority ... and may confer ... the power to make further delegations","parent_excerpt":"the power to redelegate functions, and to authorize the successive redelegation of functions","explanation":"Both use materially similar successive-redelegation machinery for administering the conferred authority."},{"child_excerpt":"The provisions of Part I of this order are hereby extended to the Department of Commerce","parent_excerpt":"To the Secretary of Commerce with respect to all materials and facilities except as provided","explanation":"Both place substantial national-defense production or procurement responsibilities in Commerce within a multiagency allocation of authority."}]}
